integrity: Statement and proof use an explicit branchwise classification. Polynomial coefficients were checked by independent shortest-path subset enumeration on finite examples. No independent mathematical assessment has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite caterpillar trees with arbitrary nonnegative pendant-leaf profiles; no assertion about noncaterpillar trees, all maximal sets, unimodality, or bit complexity. Exhaustive small computations do not replace the infinite-family proof. Completeness of priority search is not guaranteed.
title: Complete general-position polynomials of arbitrary caterpillar trees
